title: Niyâ garuq cineh yan xongolo
intro: Buxah addah maaqatta baatih katayta kasaara, uxih inki sabhalal le xongolo niya garuq cineh. Qur'aanak inki seeco sabri milaagi ximmo fan korsa; atu woo xongolok derret yan numuh rortitte gorrissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu barkat qawwalaylat gibbate buxah marih addat sabri xongolok suge.
Anu gadda kee xayloh wayti foyyah yan buxah addal raaqe.
Anu woo biyak woo waklenta yoogoreh yanim eexegeh, xagar kaak biyaakite.
Gibdaabina toobbe waqdi, Yalli kassiisak seece.
Anu inki maybalaalaqa xayyoyseh: Yalli numma, tonnal sabrit sug.
Anu Ayyub migaaqal seece; tohuk lakal Yalli gibdaabina duugeh buxa mara gacse.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?

Nabi Nuuc Barra

Nabi Yaqub Barra.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Ayyub lih raqtam kasaara kee biyaakah, tokkeek sabrih seeco
umaadoobale ayyunta caba gitah yan farmoyti takkaawisa.
Fooca fanah samad ubkah dooqa aba
Naguusinni casbih buxah addal soono maqnisaanama
Daqar xaqut amaanat le awka gorrisaanama
trial.answer: Ayyub lih raqtam kasaara kee biyaakah, tokkeek sabrih seeco

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: Yalli numma kinnim maybalaalaqa kee sabri faxximta .
raceenah xaqut tan caxaaxuwi caxa
Mojat allah tan doonik xisoonuh seeco
Taban kee inki cutuk kee tawqeh tan ayro soono.
Qabli weeqaytih xaqut quuken girib
location.answer: Yalli numma kinnim maybalaalaqa kee sabri faxximta .

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Ayyub gandi duugumteh kay buxah mari yuduureh
der udduruh qammalsimak suge alqi salaatak lakal yomcowweh
Qunxa mirac malcina sanatih mangaa kee dagna maqniseh
Aamanti le awki caxitta leek cattimeh
Maabitina finqa weeqi naharal
outcome.answer: Ayyub gandi duugumteh kay buxah mari yuduureh
